description: cmdr internal-ship --dry-run runs a real ship's refusals and checks on the branch's tip and never moves main. Each branch adds its files to a small module on main; the cases run in order, and the last is a real ship, so a dry run's pass means what a ship's does.

files.demo.go:
package demo

func Answer() int { return 1 }

broken-build.demo.go:
package demo

func Answer() int { return missing }

cases.name: a branch that does not build
a branch whose app test fails
a branch that is not there
the same branch, shipped for real
